raw_model_deviations.issue: The article says the contract workers completed exchanges “with users,” replacing the call recipients identified in the Ledger as businesses or stores. This changes who the workers were speaking with.
raw_model_deviations.explanation: The Ledger describes calls to businesses or stores and exchanges with the other party; “with users” changes the interaction’s counterparty. The unsupported counterparty substitution also changes the actor relationship.

raw_model_deviations.issue: “One helper meant one more person handling private data” presents actual additional handling of private data as certain, although the Ledger records an employee concern that sensitive information might be shared with contract staff.
raw_model_deviations.explanation: The sentence turns a reported possibility and privacy concern into definite data handling. This conflicts with the Ledger’s constraint that the concern does not establish actual information sharing.
same_fact_id_locations: These workers did more than make the conversation smooth: the user’s sensitive information might be shared with contract workers at a call center.
violation_spans: One helper meant one more person handling private data.
